preamble: Paxos Parliament (Complex): The Part-Time Parliament meets once more. Callimachos, Themiston, Kleio, Elianos, and Herodoros attempt to pass a decree amidst absences and hall disruptions. Kleio is missing at the outset, and soon after the chamber splits into isolated groups. Callimachos’s decree cannot gather a quorum. When Kleio returns and the legislators reconvene, Elianos initiates a new proposal, allowing the assembly to finally reach a consistent decree.

events.data: The chamber opens, but one clerk's desk sits empty—Kleio is nowhere to be found.
A sudden disruption in the hallway divides the assembly into two separate groups.
Callimachos puts forward a decree: 'Lower the olive tax by one drachma.'
Decree: Lower the olive tax by one drachma.
The decree stalls—insufficient responses from the divided assembly.
Kleio finally returns, parchment in hand. The hall begins to settle.
Elianos issues a fresh decree proposal—one that can finally reach the full quorum.
Decree: Lower the olive tax by one drachma.
